rules.text: A change to headings 8201 through 8206 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to subheading 8207.13 from any other chapter; or
(B) A change to subheading 8207.13 from heading 8209 or subheading 8207.19, provided that there is a regional value content of not less than:
(i) 35 percent when the build-up method is used, or
(ii) 45 percent when the build-down method is used.
A change to subheadings 8207.19 through 8207.90 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to headings 8208 through 8215 from any other chapter; or
(B) A change to subheadings 8211.91 through 8211.93 from subheading 8211.95, whether or not there is also a change from another chapter, provided there is a regional value content of not less than:
(i) 35 percent when the build-up method is used, or
(ii) 45 percent when the build-down method is used.
